answer: Vertex-burn bond: each identity claims one inlet vertex, plants a yarrow seal, and locks 70 credits. Each epoch a comet sweep replays the public vertex table; a missing or copied yarrow seal burns its bond. First filing 35, the k-th 35+6(k-1); 1,000 fake identities cost 3,032,000 plus 70,000 locked versus a 40,000 pool. A rented-vertex ring fails: one seal serves one vertex. An honest identity pays 35 once, recovers it after a clean epoch.
